info.title: SIAKAD API
info.description: SIAKAD API for the mobile app. Log in with `POST /auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer {token}` and, for users with several roles, `X-Role: {role}` (e.g. `student`, `teacher`, `guardian`). Errors are `{"message", "errors"}` (validation, 422) or `{"message", "code"}`. Lists are paginated (`data`, `links`, `meta`). See docs/API.md.

get.description:
Call it after login and at app start: roles, the role this request acts in, and whether the password
must be changed first.

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: The role to act in, one of the user's `roles`. Needed when the user holds more than one; a role the user does not hold gives 403 `role_not_held`.

get.description:
Which profile depends on the role: mahasantri, muhadhir, wali santri, or staff (name and email).
`editable` lists the fields `PATCH /profile` accepts.

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: The role to act in, one of the user's `roles`. Needed when the user holds more than one; a role the user does not hold gives 403 `role_not_held`.

patch.description:
Only the fields in `editable` of `GET /profile`; others are ignored. A new photo is sent as multipart
field `photo` (JPG/PNG).

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: The role to act in, one of the user's `roles`. Needed when the user holds more than one; a role the user does not hold gives 403 `role_not_held`.

put.description: Also replaces a temporary password. Other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in.

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: The role to act in, one of the user's `roles`. Needed when the user holds more than one; a role the user does not hold gives 403 `role_not_held`.

get.description: Public, so the login screen can use it. Image URLs are public and change when the image changes.

push_enabled.description: Whether the server sends push messages through Firebase yet (v6 D39).

post.description:
With the ID number (NIM, NIDM, guardian code or staff login) and password. Accounts with two-factor
authentication first get `422` with `code: "two_factor_required"`; send the login again with `code`
(from the authenticator app) or a `recovery_code`. Send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: The role to act in, one of the user's `roles`. Needed when the user holds more than one; a role the user does not hold gives 403 `role_not_held`.

LoginRequest.description: The login body, documented from the rules IssueApiToken applies.

username.description: NIM, NIDM, guardian code or staff login ID.

device_name.description: Shown in the list of devices, e.g. "Samsung A54".

code.description: The 6-digit code of the authenticator app, after `two_factor_required`.

recovery_code.description: Instead of `code`: one of the recovery codes.

count.description: Grouped notifications (e.g. new messages in one room) count how many they stand for.

PasswordRequest.description: The password change body. ChangeOwnPassword applies the full password policy.

password.description: The password policy of the server applies (in production: 12+ characters, mixed case, numbers, symbols).

PasswordRequest.title: PasswordRequest

ProfileRequest.description:
Every field a profile may have. Which ones apply depends on the role
(`editable` of GET /profile); UpdateOwnProfile validates them in full and
ignores the rest.

photo.description: JPG or PNG, sent as multipart.
